retained_foundations: The full B8.25a model for the selected period family requires integral theta functions on the marked cover with the prescribed transformation, a distinguished leading term on every centred degeneration trait, and identification of the resulting normalized blow-up with the prescribed fan. GRT58–60 give the invariant germ, ideal and ample twist on these hypotheses. The comparison of the marked family and its explicit period map with that chart throughout B9.01 is still inherited.

The reference intersection system and resolution, including multilinearity, projection, changes of metric and their applicability on the normal models, enter as specified in B8.25a. GRT44–45 and GRT55 verify convergence for the particular singular metrics used in the wall calculation.

GRT34 provides the two localized Newton identities. GRT52 supplies the host-uniform determinant bound and GRT57 supplies the fixed-tower wall estimate. The original link_step takes additional global chart and intersection data. This module alone cannot establish all dependencies of the two endpoint theorems.

formal_consumer.scope: On the marked global PEL model, GRT37–45 give the dense upper test, transport of component heights and the adjacent-root square with the prescribed singular metrics. GRT46–52 identify the finite determinant and transfer its CM value to the abelian interior and the boundary quotient. GRT53–57 prove the finite-curve, horizontal and mixed-intersection estimates on each fixed split wall and feed them into GRT7. GRT58–60 derive descent of the boundary ideal from the integral theta class-sum and trait hypotheses, including at residue characteristics dividing a stabilizer order.
